Welcome.Specialist.other:
👋 Welcome back!

Your bot accepts online bookings from clients and helps you run your practice:
• 📅 Clients can book through the app any time — all you need to do is confirm
• 🔔 Automatic reminders to clients and notifications to you
• 🔁 Recurring sessions and repeating schedules
• 👥 Client base with visit history and notes
• 📊 Revenue and workload analytics

Use the buttons below:
• "Manage" opens the admin mini app
• "Preview" shows the client-facing page
• "App" / "Preview" / "Help" stay pinned in the keyboard
• /profile opens your profile menu and referrals

✨ This is the alpha version — all features are free for everyone. Some features will become paid over time.

Help.Client.other:
This is a bot for online booking with a specialist.

What you can do:
• Choose a convenient date and time
• Book a session
• View and cancel your bookings

Press the "Book" button below or /start to open the app.

Help.Specialist.other: You are the owner of this bot. How to set up: 1. Open "Manage" — Profile — fill in name, photo, description 2. Services and prices — add session types 3. Schedule — set working hours 4. Days off — mark non-working dates Quick access: • "App" opens the admin mini app • "Preview" opens your client-facing page • "Help" opens this guide • /profile opens your profile menu and referrals How booking works: • A client books — you get a notification • Confirm or decline right in the chat • All bookings are visible in the admin panel Link for clients (send it to them): %s Commands: /start — Main menu /admin — Open admin mini app /profile — Open profile menu /help — This help /language — Change language

Help.SpecialistSupport.other: 💬 Need help? Contact an operator at @%s — tap "Operator support" in the menu.

Referral.InviteMessage.other: 🤝 Partner program Invite fellow specialists to the platform and earn rewards when they subscribe. 📌 How it works • Send the link below to a specialist who wants to accept bookings via Telegram. • They onboard and get the core features free. • Some of the current features will move to a paid tier, and we're rolling out advanced tools for power users. • When the invited specialist pays their first subscription, the referral becomes active and you earn a reward. 🧪 The platform is free during alpha. Rewards start accruing once the paid version launches — invites made now will be kept. 🔗 Your link: {{.Link}} Stats live in the admin panel → Settings → Referrals (active / pending).

Master.Welcome.other:
👋 Hello! I'll help you create a bot for online booking of your clients.

🎯 What you'll get:
• A personal bot with your name (@your_name_bot)
• Clients book themselves — you just confirm
• Calendar, services and prices — everything is customizable
• Notifications about new bookings right in Telegram

⏱ Setup takes 2 minutes.

📝 First step — create a bot in Telegram:

1. Open @BotFather (click the link)
2. Send the /newbot command
3. Enter a name (e.g. "Specialist John")
4. Enter a username (e.g. specialist_john_bot)
5. Copy the token — a long string of numbers and letters

Send me your bot token:

MasterMenu.Home.other:
👋 Hi! I'll help you launch your own Telegram bot for client bookings.

What your bot does:
• 📅 Accepts online bookings 24/7 via a Mini App
• 🔔 Sends automatic reminders to clients and notifications to you
• 🔁 Handles recurring sessions and repeating schedules
• 👥 Keeps a client base with visit history and notes
• 📊 Shows revenue and workload analytics
• 🎁 Referral program — invite other specialists and earn bonuses

Setup takes a couple of minutes — you'll get your own bot with your name and avatar.

Already have a bot and need to rotate its token? Use /replacetoken only if you know exactly what you are doing.

💬 If you run into questions or issues during setup, FAQ, or token recovery — contact an operator.

Pick an option:

MasterMenu.FAQIndex.other: ℹ️ Frequently asked questions Pick a topic:

MasterMenu.BtnFAQBotHow.other: 🤖 How to create a bot via BotFather

MasterFAQ.BotHow.other: 🤖 How to create a bot via BotFather Don't worry — it takes 2 minutes and our operator can help at any step. 1. Open @BotFather in Telegram 2. Send /newbot 3. Pick a name for the bot (e.g. "Ivan — massage") 4. Pick a username ending in bot (e.g. ivan_massage_bot) 5. Copy the long token BotFather sends you 6. Come back here, tap "🤖 Create my bot" and paste the token Stuck? Tap "💬 Talk to operator" and we'll walk you through it.

MasterFAQ.Usage.other: 📱 How to use the service • After registration you get your own bot — share its link with clients. • Clients book themselves inside Telegram: pick date, duration, time. • You get a notification and confirm/decline with a single button. • Calendar, services, prices, recurring bookings and analytics live inside the mini-app. • Everything configurable from inside Telegram.

MasterFAQ.Pricing.other: 💳 Pricing & terms The service is free during the beta. If paid features appear later we'll announce them ahead of time and keep your current setup working. Questions about terms? Tap "💬 Talk to operator".

MasterSupport.Welcome.other: 💬 You're connected to an operator Describe your question — we'll reply right here. Text, photos, voice messages and documents all work. To end the chat, just stop replying — you can come back any time.

MasterReplace.Prompt.other:
🔑 Replace token for @%s

⚠️ Use this only if you know what you are doing. This is an advanced recovery action for a bot you already own.

Open @BotFather → /mybots → pick your bot → API Token → /revoke if needed, then send me the new long token.

Send /cancel to abort.

MasterReplace.UsernameMismatch.other:
❌ That token belongs to a different bot (@%s instead of @%s).

Please send a token for *your* bot — I won't let you swap credentials between bots.

MasterReplace.Success.other: ✅ Token replaced. @%s is live again — you can share /start with clients.
